data.long_meaning: The name Riannon is derived from the Welsh language and means 'little queen'. In Welsh mythology, Riannon was a queen who bore twins by a mysterious lover. After her children were born, she was accused of infanticide and was cursed to carry them on her back for the rest of her life. The name Riannon carries the meaning “Little Queen” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Riannon usually hope their child will grow to embody little queen and live with faith, good character and purpose.
